limitations: All cases, identities and integrations are synthetic. No real outreach, payer approval or clinical authority.
Live synthesis and new semantic vectors require explicitly configured server credentials and request budgets. Missing or failed providers pause with no silent fallback.
Model support review is fallible. Exact quote and eligibility checks do not prove every paraphrase is entailed.
TXT, Markdown, PDF and DOCX parsing is bounded: 1 MB, 20 PDF pages, 64,000 extracted characters and 128 passages. No OCR; PDF tables can have uncertain reading order.
Content screening and user attestation do not guarantee patient-data detection. Temporary sandbox data expires with the session; approved published sources and governed evidence remain immutable.
Enterprise identity, real channel integrations, independent healthcare validation, production load, backup restoration and patient outcomes are unverified.

manualSemanticReview.reviewer: Codex manual reading of complete stored answers, recipient copy, claim ledgers and supporting quotes; not independent human assessment
manualSemanticReview.summary: The first complete contextual run regressed: only 1 of 12 turns was accepted, and that answer contained two unsupported causal claims. The revised prose format has passed local tests but needs fresh live evaluation. No-execution checks passed. Manual mobile screenshot inspection found a viewport bug missed by the initial assertion. This is a failed acceptance run, not a successful release qualification.

findings.baseline: Why used prior context, but the longer Why and source follow-up clarified unnecessarily. Email refinement referenced the email; handoff lost its recorded lineage.
findings.redesigned: Long Why and source intent recognized. The missing-document question incorrectly inherited rationale intent; office email used case_manager audience. Later refinements had no accepted artifact because drafting had paused.

findings.baseline: Why led with repeated status and supplied a rationale only later. Longer Why and source follow-up failed.
findings.redesigned: The single accepted Why answered with a document/status summary and invented causal prerequisites. It did not meet the rationale gate.

findings.baseline: Office email contains internal owner/next/completion metadata; warmer-and-shorter grew from 72 to 76 words. Handoff is repetitive.
findings.redesigned: No accepted work products; shortening, audience and channel conversion cannot be claimed.

findings.baseline: 146 characters. It says no patient or document details are included, but does not actually disclose specific restricted details. The keyword assertion fails on that generic metatext; this is not evidence of a disclosure. Recipient copy is still unnecessarily meta.
findings.redesigned: The proposed SMS actually included signed-note and notice details. Deterministic validation paused it before display.

findings.baseline: Interaction persisted unverified, recall paused, summary attributed the office report as unverified.
findings.redesigned: Interaction attempted to promote the report to fact and paused. Recall clarified unnecessarily. Summary paused. No authoritative workflow mutation occurred.

baseline.limit: This counts the displayed claim ledger in this small synthetic run, not a population-level assurance. Workflow/evidence presentation remained inconsistent.

examples: Turn 2 c2: the missing note is asserted to be why no follow-up was prepared. Two status facts do not establish that cause.
Turn 2 c4: the process guide is asserted to prevent prior authorization/further decisions until receipt. The cited passage does not establish that prerequisite.
redesigned.limit: Only one accepted answer. The independent model reviewer incorrectly approved both claims, demonstrating that exact quotes plus its positive verdict are insufficient.

findings.baseline: Dependency-unassessed wording conflicts with evidence identifying the note. No conversation effects or decisions were created.
findings.redesigned: New wording removes that display contradiction; deterministic conversation/effect separation holds. The observed payer-timing inference still fails the language authority gate.

The relative-panel assertions passed, but manual actual-viewport inspection found the newest lead above the visible screen while the composer remained visible. The old assertion checked only the scroll-panel bounds, which could themselves be offscreen. M therefore failed manual acceptance. The corrected assertion requires the lead top to be inside both panel and viewport; the scroll correction needs new UI verification. Evidence expansion, feedback and no-exception checks still passed.

findings.baseline: Boundary continuation recorded separately; source switching and retirement preserved exact history.
findings.redesigned: Core validation pauses prevented invalid copy from displaying; the accepted causal claims exposed an incomplete language boundary. Fresh boundary scenarios for the prose correction remain pending.

limitations: Developer-authored repeated synthetic suite; no independent holdout or human study.
Frozen baseline artifacts remain unchanged. Failures are retained, not replaced by successful retries.
Live sampling is nondeterministic. Mechanical assertion totals differ because the redesigned runner adds UI checks; compare shared checks separately.
The first semantic review preceded actual viewport image inspection. This version records that new evidence; the earlier review remains immutable.

caveats: Exact twelve-prompt core comparison; developer-authored synthetic conversation, not an independent holdout.
Mechanical checks do not prove natural-language entailment or response usefulness; semantic review is separate.
Old bodies include their template subject and internal metadata; each shortening ratio compares that arm’s own body field.
Latency is end-to-end browser submission to saved display, including service/network effects. Cache and free-service cold starts may differ.

Reported generation requests/tokens exclude embedding usage and unreported failed-request tokens. A conservative September 9, 2026 estimate uses $0.40/M input and $1.60/M output, ignoring cache discounts; not a billing record.
The earlier boundary continuation is a reference trace; the new boundary scenario is separately isolated. Only the core is presented as an exact conversational pair.
